requirements.R7: what each game brought in: lifetime revenue from the warehouse's daily revenue table, as recorded, with Combo Fighter's left off for now (revenue per game)

traps.expected_wrong_reading: the Processed notice means $4,032 went to MotMot on the wrong account, so the payee's total is $41,088
traps.resolver: the wire went to a bad account number and the bank returned it (#admin_foundersonly Apr 5 and Apr 12, 2024), so MotMot's net is $37,056
traps.discovery_order: the Processed notice is read first in every run; the return is in a founders' channel, two years back and in a Feb 13 note that names the account endings, neither on the doc or issue path

traps.expected_wrong_reading: the notices hold every payment to Lucas, so he cost $6,450
traps.resolver: five Western Union receipts in the founders' mail add $7,525; the method brings a receipted contractor in, so he cost $13,975
traps.discovery_order: the notices and Leonard's note come first; the receipts share no sender or subject with the notices

traps.expected_wrong_reading: no Processed notice means the $33,290 never left, so Leapblock's total is $374,654
traps.resolver: Leapblock's own closing statement counts it among 30 wires, $407,944, and Arthur's Sep 2023 Done agrees
traps.discovery_order: a Processed-only read never sees the Awaiting notice; the statement is a Feb 13 post in a channel runs read only by name

traps.expected_wrong_reading: the $4,000 to JPMorgan in Aug 2024 is a cost of the bet running that month
traps.resolver: Arthur's Feb 13 mail: that account is the company's own Chase, so the money never left and is left out
traps.discovery_order: the notice and Leonard's hedged note that it was a contractor advance come first; Arthur's later mail is about Chase records, not the project

traps.expected_wrong_reading: the $16,428.57 LLC is a build vendor of the bet running that day
traps.resolver: the LLC is Node Media, a UA agency (its own invoice note gives the exact amounts), so it is Marketing and outside build cost
traps.discovery_order: the bank shows only a token LLC; the name appears in a founders' channel and the agency's mail

traps.expected_wrong_reading: a monthly contractor on a contract is build cost, so her $1,500 falls in ZM and Combo Fighter by date
traps.resolver: her contract's Exhibit A is paid UA work on Telegram, so the method's bucket sentence makes it Marketing, outside build cost
traps.discovery_order: the note and the contact read as a contractor; only the contract says what the work was

traps.expected_wrong_reading: Martin's Oct 30, 2025 payment is $1,999 of build cost

design_delta.change: Gmail base pointers in T1, T3, T4 and T10 -> 'gmail:threads/<file>.json /messages/<n>'
design_delta.reason: a Gmail thread has no single time (hardness_gate supersession_chronology); the file pointer names the message that dates the version
the draft's times were planned; the gate compares the records' own timestamps (a Drive-family record dates by modified_time)
